item.title: GameSir Launches G7 Pro Dragon’s Dogma 2 Edition Controller
item.description: Inspired by the world of Dragon’s Dogma, GameSir has unveiled the G7 Pro Dragon’s Dogma 2 Edition – a next-generation controller designed for precision, power, and platform versatility.

item.title: FSP Introduces U590 E-ATX Chassis Featuring Full-Mesh Panels
item.description: FSP has unveiled the U590, a new E-ATX ultra tower chassis designed to deliver high-performance cooling alongside a bold, modern aesthetic.

item.title: ASUS Announces Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus Series Support on W880, Z890, Q870, B860 and H810 Motherboards
item.description: ASUS has announced full support for Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus Series processors across its Intel 800 series motherboard lineup, including W880, Z890, Q870, B860, and H810 models.

item.title: Super Flower Launches Thunder Panoramic PC Case with Angled Cooling Design
item.description: Super Flower has expanded its growing chassis lineup with the launch of the new Thunder mid-tower PC case, featuring a panoramic dual-chamber layout with angled cooling design.

item.title: CHUWI Issues Statement on CoreBook CPU Controversy, Offers Full Refunds, AMD to Take Action
item.description: Following earlier reports of CPU discrepancies in the CoreBook X and CoreBook Plus, CHUWI has issued an official response claiming a production error behind the issue.

item.title: TEAMGROUP Launches T-CREATE CLASSIC H514 M.2 PCIe 5.0 SSD
item.description: TEAMGROUP announced the launch of the T-CREATE CLASSIC H514 M.2 PCIe 5.0 SSD, designed to meet the growing demand for high-performance data storage in the generative AI era.

item.title: GIGABYTE and ASRock Roll Out BIOS Updates for AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Processor
item.description: GIGABYTE and ASRock have announced BIOS updates to support the newly introduced AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition processor, bringing compatibility and performance enhancements to their respective AM5 motherboard line-ups.

item.title: MSI Announces BIOS Updates To Support AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition CPU
item.description: MSI is excited to introduce full support for the upcoming AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition processor, built on cutting-edge Zen 5 architecture and powered by next-generation AMD 3D V-Cache technology.

item.title: ASRock Z890 Taichi 10th Anniversary Edition Teased Ahead of Launch
item.description: ASRock appears to be preparing a special edition motherboard to celebrate a decade of its Taichi series, as the Z890 Taichi 10th Anniversary has surfaced in ASRock

item.title: ASUS Adds ZenMouse MD202 To Peripheral Lineup
item.description: ASUS has introduced the ZenMouse MD202, a premium wireless mouse featuring a Ceraluminum design and multi-device wireless connectivity.

item.title: Noctua and Asetek Flagship AIO Coolers Target Q2 2026 Launch
item.description: Noctua, a leading quiet PC cooling brand, and Asetek, a pioneer in all-in-one (AIO) liquid cooling, have announced a key milestone in the development of their next-generation flagship AIO coolers.

item.title: ASUS Announces ExpertBook B3 G1 and ExpertBook P5 G1 Business Laptops
item.description: ASUS has introduced two new business laptop series  the ExpertBook B3 G1 and ExpertBook P5 G1  designed to address the evolving needs of enterprise users and modern professionals.

item.title: Cooler Master Introduces MasterLiquid Core LCD 360 4-inch AIO Cooler
item.description: Cooler Master has announced the MasterLiquid Core LCD 360 4-inch, a new all-in-one liquid cooler designed to combine thermal performance with system customisation.

item.title: EK Water Blocks Presents the EK-Quantum Vector³ TUF RTX 5070 Ti/5080 - Plexi
item.description: This new full-cover water block is compatible with the ASUS TUF models of both RTX 5070 Ti and 5080, offering a compelling appearance and great cooling.
